firecrawl-skills-core-firecrawl.description: Any live-web task via the Firecrawl CLI — including ordinary web research: searching the web, reading or extracting pages, gathering sources, discovering site URLs, bulk extraction, downloading a site, change alerts, or pages needing clicks/login — web only; local files route to firecrawl-parse. For US legal or regulatory questions use gov; for papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.

firecrawl-skills-core-firecrawl-agent.description: Autonomously navigate websites and extract structured data across pages. Use when the task requires navigation or no suitable ready-made workflow or data provider covers it.

firecrawl-skills-core-firecrawl-alexandr.description: Find a direct path to structured data through ready-made workflows, data APIs, and indexes. Follow the search skill to discover and inspect tools, then the scrape skill to execute them.

firecrawl-skills-workflows-firecrawl-dem.author: firecrawl

Use before answering when the user names a version, is upgrading, pastes an error from a library or tool, or asks how to use, configure or migrate a specific library or API. Model knowledge stops at a training cutoff and misses new releases, renamed APIs, changed defaults and recent fixes, so when a version, option, error or API is unfamiliar or may have changed, look it up instead of guessing. firecrawl-skills-core-firecrawl-download.description: Save a site or section as local files (markdown, screenshots). Use for "download the site", offline docs, or a local copy for reference.

firecrawl-skills-core-firecrawl-interact.description: Drive a live browser on a scraped page: click, fill forms, log in, paginate, infinite-scroll. Use when content requires interaction or a scrape failed or returned incomplete content.

firecrawl-skills-workflows-firecrawl-job.description: Find current job postings on employer career pages and job boards. Use when the user asks who's hiring, seeks remote or local jobs, or wants openings matched to their role, skills, experience, or salary preferences.
firecrawl-skills-workflows-firecrawl-job.author: firecrawl

firecrawl-skills-workflows-firecrawl-kno.description: Build a knowledge base from web content with Firecrawl. Use for local reference docs, RAG-ready chunks, fine-tuning datasets, documentation mirrors, topic corpora, or LLM-ready markdown organized from web sources.
